verdict.rationale: Helicone offers a query language (HQL) and REST API for point queries, plus a one-line export to PostHog for dashboards, showing some data-access capability, but there is no documented feature for bulk exporting traces/datasets specifically to blob storage (S3/GCS) or a data warehouse (BigQuery/Snowflake/Redshift). missing for 10: explicit blob storage export, data warehouse connectors, bulk/batch export tooling or documentation.
